newsitem.title: POLAND: Merrill Lynch keeps BIG neutral rating.
newsitem.headline: Merrill Lynch keeps BIG neutral rating.

text.p: Merrill Lynch advised investors to hold Bank Inicjatyw Gospodarczych SA (BIG) in medium term and recommended accumulating the shares in the long-term, stressing its expected earnings growth, Merrill Lynch said.
"We expect BIG to outperform due to above average earnings growt and multiple expansion," it said in a report dated October 16.
Merrill Lynch sees BIG's net profit at 56 million zlotys this fiscal year ending September 30, after a 43 million zloty profit after nine months of the year.
It said that, at the time of the report, it was trading just below the 1996 price objective of 4.40 zlotys, therefore it maintained its neutral intermediate stance.
But it aimed at 5.80 zlotys next year.
Nomura raised BIG's 1996 consolidated net income forecast to 111 million zlotys from 104 million and the 1997 forecast by five percent to 138 million zlotys.
BIG closed at 3.5 zlotys on Friday.
